module: Flowgraph node "On Mission Start/Stop" (category repeat_instant, ui color/icon). Detects when the player starts (onMissionStartWithFade hook) or stops (onAnyMissionChanged with the 'stopped' state) a mission. Impulse outputs: started and stopped.
notes: work() sets back to false only started; stopped is never explicitly set back to false after being raised (probably an oversight). An "abandoned" output is commented out.

work.desc: Every frame: started to false, applies then clears the flags.

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook: raises stopped when the new state is 'stopped'.
